title: WPMS/2314/2019 of SUNITA Vs HINDUSTAN PEROLEUM CORPORATION LIMITED

paras.text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND AT NAINITAL
Writ Petition (M/S) No. 2314 of 2019
Smt. Sunita
 ÖÖÖÖ.Petitioner
Versus
Hindustan Petroleum Corporation Limited and others
 ÖÖ...Respondents
Present : Mr. Parikshit Saini, Advocate for the petitioner.
Ms. Menka Tripathi, Advocate for the respondents.
Honíble Sudhanshu Dhulia, J. (Oral)
 The petitioner before this Court had given his
two oil tankers to a transporter on lease/rent. The
transporter had entered into a contract with the
respondent oil company for transport of the oil. On
inspection, some unauthorized fittings were found in the
tanker bearing registration no. UK17CA 1559 of the
transporter company called M/s Salman Carrier.
Consequently, the oil company terminated the contract
with the transporter company vide order dated
03.04.2019, and not only the contract was terminated but
the entire fleet of the transporter company was blacklisted
in terms of the conditions of the contract.
2. The petitioner has filed the present writ petition
challenging the order dated 03.04.2019 stating that she is
not at a fault and anomaly, if at all, has been committed
by the transporter company and the collateral liability has
wrongly been fixed upon the petitioner.
3. This argument of the petitioner is not tenable
for the reason that the transporter company had also filed
a writ petition being Writ Petition (M/S) No. 1857 of 2019)
challenging the termination of contract. The writ petition

2
was dismissed by this Court vide order dated 27.06.2019,
inter alia, on ground that there is an arbitration clause.
4. This Court has also been informed that against
the order dated 27.06.2019, the transporter had filed a
special appeal being Special Appeal No. 716 of 2019,
which has also been dismissed.
5. The present petitioner does not have a better
right or claim than the transporter company, whose writ
petition and special appeal have already been dismissed.
Whatever rights the petitioner has, the same are against
the transporter company. However, as far as this writ
petition is concerned, no interference is called for by this
Court.
6. In view thereof, writ petition fails and is hereby
dismissed.
